page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The server is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 1.85 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage or discrete GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, facilitating inter-node data transfers across cloud infrastructure. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its high dedicated vCPU count relative to memory allocation, the hardware profile delivers high compute capacity for CPU-bound workloads. This provisioning balance offers qualitative cost efficiency for parallel processing, continuous integration build pipelines, batch data rendering, and web application cluster nodes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. It provides 52 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 96.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a resource ratio of 1.85 GB per core. The instance lacks local storage and discrete GPU acceleration, relying entirely on network-attached storage solutions. Network throughput is backed by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The high core density makes this server cost-effective for compute-heavy parallel workloads, batch processing, build compilation, web application processing, and scientific calculation tasks where thread count is prioritized over high memory-per-core allocation.
